_note: Reviewed, photograph-only suggestions (PRD 10.6). Every text is scanned against banned_phrases.txt [quests] when loaded. Avoid words that start with a banned phrase (for example 'petal' starts with 'pet').

templates.text: Find a leaf with an unusual shape and photograph it.
Find three different leaf shapes and photograph each one.
Look up and photograph a bird from a safe distance.
Photograph something smooth and something rough.
Find something with six legs and photograph it from a respectful distance.
Photograph a flower in a colour you rarely notice.
Find something round in nature and photograph it.
